title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1+2 PER SHITJE PRANE ISH EKSPOZITES !
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1+2 prane Ish ekspozites.
Ndodhet ne katin e 8 (i fundit) ne nje pallat ndertim i vitit 2005 me ashensor.
Apartamenti organizohet ne ambient ndenje me dalje ne ballkon, korridori i cili ben shperndarjen ne dy dhoma gjumi dhe dy tualete.
Orientimi Lindje.
Zona eshte nga me te lakmuarat ne kryeqytet.
Disponon certifikate pronesie.
title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE NEAR THE FORMER EXHIBITION!
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale near the former exhibition. It is located on the 8th (last) floor of a building built in 2005 with an elevator. The apartment is organized in a living room with access to the balcony, the corridor which is divided into two bedrooms and two bathrooms. Orientation East. The area is one of the most coveted in the capital. It has ownership certificates.
